# Levent Kurtis

> Data & AI consultant and team lead at Accenture in Copenhagen, Denmark.
> Works at the intersection of Data & AI, people, and delivery.

## Summary

Levent Kurtis is a Senior Business Architecture Analyst at Accenture in
Copenhagen. He advises clients on data-driven transformation and implements the
solutions that follow, covering data migration, data quality frameworks,
analytics, automation, and ML/AI adoption. He combines hands-on technical work
with a digital business background, bridging technical teams and executive
stakeholders.

## Current role

- **Data Migration Stream Lead, Accenture** (06/2026 to present). Leads the
  Dynamics 365 data migration workstream on a large-scale public sector
  programme, acting as liaison between the client and the offshore ETL team, and
  leading a team of 3 consultants.

## Previous roles

- **Team Lead, Accenture** (01/2025 to 05/2026)
- **Data & AI Consultant, Accenture** (09/2023 to 12/2024)
- **Researcher, Marcher Markholt** (11/2021 to 08/2023)
- **E-commerce Assistant, Accord** (12/2020 to 10/2021)
- **E-commerce Assistant, Retail Brands** (08/2019 to 08/2020)

## Education

MSc in Business Administration and E-business, Copenhagen Business School.

## Core skills

SQL, Python, Databricks, Power BI, data analysis, automation, KNIME, LM Studio,
Ollama, agile delivery, SAFe, Azure DevOps, PI planning, team leadership,
stakeholder management, digital transformation.

## Languages
